title: A and B and Compilation Errors
titleZh: A 和 B 以及编译错误
statementMd:
*A and B are preparing themselves for programming contests.*

B loves to debug his code. But before he runs the solution and starts debugging, he has to first compile the code.

Initially, the compiler displayed $*n*$ compilation errors, each of them is represented as a positive integer. After some effort, B managed to fix some mistake and then another one mistake.

However, despite the fact that B is sure that he corrected the two errors, he can not understand exactly what compilation errors disappeared — the compiler of the language which B uses shows errors in the new order every time! B is sure that unlike many other programming languages, compilation errors for his programming language do not depend on each other, that is, if you correct one error, the set of other error does not change.

Can you help B find out exactly what two errors he corrected?

## Input

The first line of the input contains integer $*n*$ ($3 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}$) — the initial number of compilation errors.

The second line contains $*n*$ space-separated integers $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ ($1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$) — the errors the compiler displayed for the first time.

The third line contains $*n* - 1$ space-separated integers $*b*_{1}, *b*_{2}, ..., *b*_{*n* - 1}$ — the errors displayed at the second compilation. It is guaranteed that the sequence in the third line contains all numbers of the second string except for exactly one.

The fourth line contains $*n* - 2$ space-separated integers $*с*_{1}, *с*_{2}, ..., *с*_{*n* - 2}$ — the errors displayed at the third compilation. It is guaranteed that the sequence in the fourth line contains all numbers of the third line except for exactly one.

## Output

Print two numbers on a single line: the numbers of the compilation errors that disappeared after B made the first and the second correction, respectively.

## Note

In the first test sample B first corrects the error number 8, then the error number 123.

In the second test sample B first corrects the error number 1, then the error number 3. Note that if there are multiple errors with the same number, B can correct only one of them in one step.
statementZhMd:
*A 和 B 正在为编程竞赛做准备。*

B 喜欢调试他的代码。但在运行代码并开始调试之前，他必须先编译代码。

最初，编译器显示了 $*n*$ 个编译错误，每个错误都由一个正整数表示。经过一番努力，B 成功修复了一个错误，然后又修复了另一个错误。

然而，尽管 B 确信自己修复了这两个错误，他却无法确切知道消失的是哪两个编译错误——B 所使用的编程语言的编译器每次都会以不同的顺序显示错误！B 确信，与许多其他编程语言不同，他所使用的编程语言中的编译错误彼此独立，也就是说，修复一个错误不会改变其他错误的集合。

你能帮助 B 找出他确切修复的两个错误吗？

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$3 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}$）——初始的编译错误数量。

第二行包含 $*n* 个以空格分隔的整数 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$（$1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$）——编译器第一次显示的错误。

第三行包含 $*n* - 1$ 个以空格分隔的整数 $*b*_{1}, *b*_{2}, ..., *b*_{*n* - 1}$——第二次编译时显示的错误。保证第三行中的序列包含第二行序列中的所有数字，恰好少了一个。

第四行包含 $*n* - 2$ 个以空格分隔的整数 $*с*_{1}, *с*_{2}, ..., *с*_{*n* - 2}$——第三次编译时显示的错误。保证第四行中的序列包含第三行序列中的所有数字，恰好少了一个。

## 输出格式

在一行中输出两个数字：分别表示 B 第一次和第二次修复后消失的编译错误编号。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，B 先修复了编号为 8 的错误，然后修复了编号为 123 的错误。

在第二个样例中，B 先修复了编号为 1 的错误，然后修复了编号为 3 的错误。注意，如果有多个错误具有相同的编号，B 每一步只能修复其中一个。
